purpose: Discover whether and when taking risk during a causally identified DEFENSIVE regime adds value over the contemporaneously available safe alternative, without assuming long equity exposure is required.
scientific_question: Given DEFENSIVE state and only information available at decision time, which eligible action, if any, has portable positive incremental value versus remaining in the safe asset?

governance.next_stage: preserved50 verification only after DEV50 architecture/candidates/gates are frozen
governance.subsequent_stage: TEST17 only after preserved50 predeclared gate passes

core_principles: DEFENSIVE describes the market environment; it does not dictate the direction of every security.
Individual securities remain individual research/trading objects.
Correlated same-date security outcomes are cross-sectional evidence, not independent market experiments.
Safe capital is an affirmative portfolio action, not a failed trade.
Risky exposure must earn the right to displace the contemporaneous safe alternative.
No strategy is required to trade every bear episode.
A zero-trade heldout episode is not automatically failure if the learned policy selects the safe asset because no qualifying risky opportunity exists.

action_space.SHORT_SECURITY: short an individually selected security, subject to modeled costs/borrow assumptions
action_space.LONG_MARKET: broad-market long exposure when justified despite DEFENSIVE state
action_space.PUT: not included in first return engine unless historically adequate option-chain, strike, expiry, IV, spread and transaction-cost data are available; no synthetic put-return approximation

safe_hurdle.rule: Use the contemporaneous causal short-duration Treasury/risk-free proxy available on each historical date, annualized then accrued over the actual capital holding interval.
safe_hurdle.fallback_if_required_series_missing: STOP and document missing input; do not substitute a hindsight constant such as 3 percent without a separately frozen amendment.
safe_hurdle.comparison: Evaluate risky action excess return versus safe accrual over the same capital/time interval, after modeled trading costs.

evidence_hierarchy.interpretation: Multiple securities succeeding on one date strengthen breadth/cross-sectional robustness but do not multiply the date into independent market experiments.

discovery_architecture.stage1_environment: existing causal DEFENSIVE declaration/window; no future peak/trough information may enter predictors
discovery_architecture.stage2_opportunity: search causal market plus security conditions for conditional positive excess value versus SAFE; direction may be long, short, market or security-specific
discovery_architecture.stage3_selection: when security-specific opportunity exists, rank/select individual securities using causal cross-sectional predictors
discovery_architecture.stage4_portfolio: allocate among qualifying risky actions and SAFE subject to capacity; unallocated capital remains SAFE

anti_overfit.outer_stock_folds: 5 deterministic lexicographic round-robin DEV50 folds; omitted stocks excluded during evolution
anti_overfit.outer_episode_folds: 6 leave-one-bear-out folds; omitted episode excluded during evolution
anti_overfit.same_date_weighting: aggregate economic evidence at opportunity-date level before high-level fitness; raw number of correlated ticker trades cannot multiply fitness credit
anti_overfit.episode_balance: episodes receive balanced high-level influence rather than influence proportional to row/trade count
anti_overfit.mechanism_recurrence: report recurring causal mechanism concepts across independently trained folds; do not require identical fitted numeric thresholds
anti_overfit.complexity_penalty: prefer simpler mechanisms when incremental heldout evidence does not justify added conditions/degrees of freedom
anti_overfit.sparsity: report distinct opportunity dates, securities, and episodes; high return from a tiny number of dates cannot qualify by mean return alone
anti_overfit.candidate_layer: Do not treat prior ticker-by-ticker optimized candidate events as independent evidence. Prefer direct causal raw/predictor panel opportunity construction; if old optimized candidate layer is required, STOP and document rather than silently reuse it.

fitness_and_reporting.primary_economic_quantity: incremental return over SAFE on matched capital/time interval after costs
required: exact daily MTM portfolio equity including SAFE accrual
profit concentration by date and episode
fitness_and_reporting.trade_count: activity diagnostic only; never treated as independent confirmation count
fitness_and_reporting.objective: maximize portable incremental value over SAFE while minimizing drawdown, concentration and unnecessary model complexity

advance_logic.DEV50: Complete all nested folds. Freeze recurrence findings and any candidate/gate before preserved50. Do not invent a pass threshold from preserved50/TEST17.
advance_logic.preserved50: One frozen verification replay; no mutation. Failure retained.
advance_logic.TEST17: Only if predeclared preserved50 gate passes; one frozen subsequent test; no mutation.
advance_logic.protected: No remaining Discovery or Verification A/B during redesign.

interpretation_examples.broad_decline: SHORT_MARKET, SHORT_SECURITY or SAFE may dominate; longs are not mandatory.
interpretation_examples.falling_market_with_leaders: LONG_SECURITY may be valid when causally identifiable relative-strength opportunities exceed SAFE.
interpretation_examples.capitulation_rebound: LONG_SECURITY may be valid for a short conditional rebound while regime remains DEFENSIVE.
interpretation_examples.options: If bearish underlying opportunity is validated, puts may later be compared as an execution vehicle using historically adequate option data.
